key.name: app-entries
key.description: Configured Quake-mode applications, one JSON object per entry with keys: id, appId, side, shortcut, sizePercent, spanPercent, sticky, opacity. spanPercent runs across the dock's axis - a width on top or bottom, a height on left or right - and the older widthPercent key is still read as a fallback. Unknown keys are ignored and absent keys take their default.

key.name: entries
key.description: Superseded by app-entries. Reset after migration.
